packing_check.note: Each molecule in valid_packed.npy has exact token count token_counts[split]/molecule_counts[split] (including BOS and EOS if both present, or EOS only). If eval loss averages over all non-BOS predicted tokens, per-molecule NLL = ce_per_tok * (tok_per_mol - 1) if BOS is skipped, or ce_per_tok * tok_per_mol if all packed tokens are averaged. We report both and inspect eval code to confirm which exact multiplier applies.
